# The Middleman

> A Nigerian-first marketplace for ready-made digital products from independent creators. Buyers can review listing details and pay in Naira through Paystack.

- [Home](https://themiddleman.com.ng/): Overview of The Middleman.
- [Marketplace](https://themiddleman.com.ng/marketplace): Browse public digital-product listings.
- [About](https://themiddleman.com.ng/about): Information about the project.
- [Careers](https://themiddleman.com.ng/careers): Current team and careers information.
- [Terms of Service](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/terms): Platform terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/privacy): How personal data is handled.
- [Cookie Policy](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/cookies): Cookie and browser-storage information.
- [Refund and Dispute Policy](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/refunds): Published refund information.
- [Sitemap](https://themiddleman.com.ng/sitemap.xml): Public page index.

This file is a concise guide for AI and other automated discovery tools. It is not a search-ranking signal and does not provide access to private accounts or orders.
